_comment: Host/operator-owned allowlist for the Autonomous Engineering Workstation. Ashley may READ this to decide where she may engineer; she can NEVER create or widen a project root. canonicalRoot must be a canonical absolute POSIX path and must NOT be a broad system root (/, /home, /Users, /root, or the live production checkout). The file is a top-level array; copy to ~/.composer-assistant/project-roots.json and set ASHLEY_SANDBOX_PROJECT_REGISTRY to its path.
